summary: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by normally investing at least 80% of its net assets, (a) in securities issued by closed-end funds or derivatives that provide investment exposure to closed-end funds either directly or indirectly and (b) opportunistically in long and/or short positions of (i) single name or basket securities or instruments seeking to hedge market exposure and/or (ii) derivatives instruments seeking to hedge market exposure.
